\[
R^{\delta}_f(J) = \lim_{k \to \infty} \delta^{(k)}_f(J),\qquad \delta^{(1)}_f(J) = \delta_N(J) \wedge f
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(f\): The image itself as the mask
- \(J\): The marker
- \(N\): The 3 x 3 cross or square

J is the marker, here the image moved down by h, and f is the mask, the image itself. Each geodesic step dilates J with the 3 x 3 element N and takes the minimum with f, so J never rises above f. Repeating until nothing changes gives the reconstruction. By erosion is the same with the roles of minimum and maximum swapped. The marker is first clamped below (or above) the mask. The filter uses the hybrid algorithm of Vincent and matches skimage.morphology.reconstruction.
